segments.tts: Three goals in twenty-one seconds?! Impossible!
March twenty-third, 1952. Chicago's Bill Mosienko scores three goals in just twenty-one seconds against the Rangers.
Still the fastest hat trick in NHL history.
It takes me twenty-one seconds to tie my skates.
December eighth, 1987. Flyers goalie Ron Hextall shoots the puck the length of the ice... into an empty net.
First goalie ever to shoot and score. My hero.
Walt, you've never left the crease.
March twenty-fourth, 1936. Detroit and the Montreal Maroons play six overtimes.
Sorry... almost three hours of hockey!
Mud Bruneteau finally scores at two twenty-five in the morning.
In my day, we called that a warm-up.
Wake me for the seventh overtime.
